title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
raw_excerpt: Anthropic went public on November 19th, 2026. | Photo: Getty Images Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics's most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world's best mathematicians for decades. If verified, it would mark yet another seismic achievement for AI in mathematics and add to the upheaval already unleashed by OpenAI's previous, often inelegant forays into the field. Alpöge's solution has yet to be verified independently. Anthropic has not commented or involved itself in Alpöge's announcement. summary: Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 声称借助 Claude 证明了数学界最著名的未解难题之一——黎曼猜想，若被独立验证，将是 AI 在数学领域的又一里程碑式突破。该证明尚未经过同行验证，Anthropic 也未正式表态。此事紧随 OpenAI 此前在数学领域的多次尝试，凸显 AI 正加速介入基础数学研究，也引发关于 AI 辅助证明可信度与验证机制的讨论。

title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
raw_excerpt: A new report from the AI evaluation nonprofit METR finds that some AI capabilities are continuing to improve along an exponential trajectory—but it also indicates that models aren’t quite as good at tasks that require judgment as they are at coding. The report is an update to the organization’s time horizon plot, which was widely shared— and widely misinterpreted , owing to the complexity of the measures it used. METR evaluated models by having them attempt a large suite of tasks, each of which had also been completed by humans. Each task’s difficulty was scored by how long it took the human testers to finish it—and then models were rated according to the length of the tasks that they could complete. That plot showed that AI systems were rapidly improving—every four months, the length of the tasks that frontier models could successfully complete doubled. The updated plot adds more tasks—some that are estimated to take humans far longer than those in the original suite, and others that are more open-ended. One of the biggest questions in AI right now is the extent to which progress on “verifiable” tasks—where it’s possible to check automatically whether an AI system has succeeded or failed—carry over into tasks on which success or failure is harder to measure. summary: AI 评估非营利机构 METR 更新其广受关注但常被误读的“时间跨度”图表，发现部分 AI 能力仍沿指数轨迹提升，但模型在需要判断力的任务上明显弱于编程任务。报告通过让模型完成大量人类也做过的任务，并按人类耗时衡量难度，给出更细化的能力画像。该更新对理解 AI 能力边界、预测自动化风险具有重要参考价值。

title: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day
summary: 受 Anthropic IPO 后股价大跌拖累，纳斯达克回吐 2026 年全部涨幅，AI 板块遭遇大规模抛售，标普与道指也进入回调区间。市场担忧 AI 估值过高、商业化不及预期，叠加宏观不确定性，引发连锁反应。这是 AI 热潮以来最显著的一次市场信心动摇，对行业融资节奏与估值体系可能产生深远影响。

title: Combatting adversarial distillation
raw_excerpt: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.
summary: OpenAI 发布应对“对抗性蒸馏”的分层方案，结合模型训练、安全防护、检测与执法手段，防止外部通过蒸馏提取其模型能力。随着开源与闭源模型竞争加剧，能力窃取成为核心商业风险，OpenAI 此举明确了防御思路，也为行业建立模型知识产权保护提供参考，可能推动相关检测标准与合规实践的形成。

title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen
raw_excerpt: Signal users on iOS will see this option to toggle blocking screenshots and preventing Siri AI from scanning on-screen content. | Image: Signal Signal is restricting the ability to take screenshots on Android and iOS devices in an effort to prevent AI agents from reading users' messages and other data. The agentic AI capabilities built into operating systems that analyze on-screen information to learn more about the user are "undermining Signal's ability to independently guarantee privacy," Signal president Meredith Whittaker said in a blog post , while urging OS providers to make it easier for app developers to control what data agents can access. "We want to be very clear: it is a serious problem that Signal - and application developers beyond - lack robust tools to prevent AI age … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Signal 在 iOS 与 Android 上限制截图功能，以阻止操作系统内置的 Gemini、Siri 等 AI 代理读取用户消息与屏幕内容。Signal 总裁 Meredith Whittaker 称，系统级 AI 屏幕分析正在削弱其独立保障隐私的能力，并呼吁 OS 厂商提供更明确的控制选项。这标志着隐私通讯应用与平台级 AI 之间的张力正式公开化。

title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
raw_excerpt: Google's Gemini API introduces Tool Retrieval, enabling dynamic function execution like issuing refunds based on input. Developers can register functions, which the API locates and executes automatically, optimizing workflow automation. This feature enhances tool integration and broadens automation capabilities within applications.
summary: Google 在 Gemini API 中推出 Tool Retrieval 功能，开发者可注册函数，API 能根据输入自动定位并执行相应工具，例如按条件发起退款。该功能将工具调用从静态配置升级为动态检索执行，显著提升工作流自动化能力，降低集成复杂度，对构建复杂 Agent 应用的开发者具有直接价值。

title: Let Gemini tackle repetitive chores on your Mac
raw_excerpt: Computer use in the Gemini app for Mac can now help users get multi-step tasks done across their local files, desktop apps, and the web. Gemini works inside an isolated background window with a live preview right in the chat. Users' main screen and cursor remain completely free, so they can continue typing, designing, or taking calls without interruption. Users can choose which apps Gemini can access, watch every step live, pause at any time, and approve key actions before they happen.
summary: Google 为 Mac 版 Gemini 应用加入“计算机使用”能力，可在隔离的后台窗口中跨本地文件、桌面应用和网页完成多步骤任务，用户主屏幕与光标不受干扰，并可实时预览、随时暂停、逐项批准关键操作。这使 Gemini 从对话助手升级为可实际执行桌面任务的代理，是 AI 代理落地个人电脑的重要一步。

title: When Agent Swarms Outperform Solo Coders
raw_excerpt: Replit's optimization benchmark found 32 Opus agents achieved an 18.9× NumPy workload speedup versus 3.7× for one agent within two hours, using more compute. Gains depended on separable tasks and shared coordination boards. The strongest solo model's performance declined as teams grew.
summary: Replit 的优化基准测试显示，32 个 Opus 智能体组成的集群在两小时内实现 18.9 倍 NumPy 工作负载加速，而单个智能体仅 3.7 倍，代价是消耗更多算力。增益依赖任务可拆分与共享协调板，且最强单体模型在团队扩大后表现反而下降。该结果量化了多智能体协作的收益与边界，对 Agent 系统设计有直接指导意义。

summary: 华为云宣布基于昇腾算力训练出在双榜单上达到 SOTA 的具身世界模型，并计划将整套底座开放。这标志着国产算力从“芯片性能”竞争转向训练效率、数据规模、部署成本与场景落地速度的多维比拼。开放底座有望降低具身智能研发门槛，推动国内具身智能生态加速形成，对国产 AI 基础设施意义重大。
